patch.value: GH-1328: linked-test execution does not disclose item evidence recording

GitHub issue #1328 reports that pm test <id> --run says changed:false both when default test-result-tracking disables item recording and when enabled tracking appends test_run_track. Background runs also report passed without item evidence. Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1328

Reproduce disabled and enabled policy paths in disposable trackers; add an explicit recorded state and reason or accurate changed field; verify foreground and background item history plus SDK and CLI parity; pass exact coverage
Linked-test results explicitly say whether execution evidence reached the item history
Agents can trust closeout evidence without inspecting a separate history stream
Prevent false assumptions that a passing linked test was recorded
Foreground and background test runs expose an accurate recording receipt and recovery command
Run pm test <id> --run with default tracking and then enabled tracking; both currently print changed:false although only the second appends test_run_track.
The run result accurately reports recording and the command to enable it when disabled.
changed:false is printed in both cases without recording provenance.
